title: Data structures coding labs with ChatGPT scaffolding
summary: Students independently complete four coding labs and then complete three labs collaboratively. The IPSSC system structures ChatGPT interaction into solution assessment, code assessment, and free interaction so students iteratively refine algorithms and code.

sources.title: Scaffolding Computational Thinking With ChatGPT
sources.evidence_quote: IPSSC was used to scaffold the students' programming during all computer lab sessions

assessment.summary: Complete seven Data Structures and Algorithms coding tasks.
student_actions: Draft and submit a solution approach for AI feedback.
Implement and submit code for specific feedback.
Work alone for four labs and with a partner for three.

student_role.description: GPT-3.5 assessed solution plans and code through three scaffolded modules.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

reported_results: Quasi-experiment with 26 students per condition across seven lab sessions; 22 matched pre/post records per group were analyzed.

evidence_excerpts.quote: IPSSC was used to scaffold the students' programming during all computer lab sessions
